facts: Born 15 June 1986. Holds an airline transport pilot certificate with an airplane multiengine rating. Holds a first-class medical certificate, examination on 14 June 2026, with no authorization for special issuance; it has not been suspended or revoked. That was the person's most recent application (issued); no other application. On 10 June 2027 the person acts as pilot in command of an airplane, exercising the privileges of the airline transport pilot certificate, in a domestic operation under part 121 that requires two pilots. 2027-06-10

Born 22 September 1986. Holds an airline transport pilot certificate with an airplane multiengine rating. Holds a first-class medical certificate, examination on 22 September 2026, with no authorization for special issuance; not suspended or revoked; no later application. On 1 April 2027 the person serves as second in command of an airplane, exercising the privileges of the airline transport pilot certificate, in a flag operation under part 121 that requires three pilots. 2027-04-01

Born 20 March 1966. Holds an airline transport pilot certificate with an airplane multiengine rating. Holds a first-class medical certificate, examination on 5 February 2026, with no authorization for special issuance; not suspended or revoked; no later application. On 15 August 2026 the person serves as second in command, a required pilot flightcrew member, exercising the privileges of the airline transport pilot certificate, in a domestic operation under part 121 that requires two pilots (not a flag or supplemental operation). 2026-08-15

Born 3 July 1966. Holds an airline transport pilot certificate with an airplane multiengine rating. Holds a second-class medical certificate, examination on 10 January 2026, with no authorization for special issuance; not suspended or revoked; no later application; has never held a first-class medical certificate. On 20 June 2026 the person serves as second in command, a required pilot flightcrew member, exercising the privileges of the airline transport pilot certificate, in a domestic operation under part 121 that requires two pilots (not a flag or supplemental operation). 2026-06-20

Born 1 August 1975. Holds a commercial pilot certificate with an airplane single-engine land rating (no airline transport pilot certificate). Holds a first-class medical certificate, examination on 12 March 2026, with no authorization for special issuance; not suspended or revoked; no later application. On 5 December 2026 the person acts as pilot in command of an airplane carrying cargo for hire, exercising the privileges of the commercial pilot certificate. 2026-12-05

Born 10 October 1980. Holds a commercial pilot certificate with a lighter-than-air category, balloon class rating (no other ratings). Holds a second-class medical certificate, examination on 7 September 2025, with no authorization for special issuance; not suspended or revoked; no later application. On 1 October 2026 the person acts as pilot in command of a balloon giving sightseeing rides to passengers for compensation; the person is not providing flight training. 2026-10-01

Born 18 April 1979. Holds a commercial pilot certificate with a lighter-than-air category, balloon class rating, and a flight instructor certificate. Last held a second-class medical certificate, examination on 3 March 2023, not suspended or revoked; no later application. On 10 April 2026 the person acts as pilot in command of a balloon, exercising the privileges of the commercial pilot certificate, and is providing flight training in accordance with 14 CFR 61.133(a)(2)(ii) to a student for compensation. 2026-04-10

Born 14 March 1971. Holds a private pilot certificate with an airplane single-engine land rating. Holds a third-class medical certificate, examination on 9 October 2024, with no authorization for special issuance; not suspended or revoked; no later application. Holds a U.S. driver's license. On 31 October 2026 the person acts as pilot in command of an airplane, exercising private pilot privileges; the flight is not conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2026-10-31

Born 2 February 2004. Holds a student pilot certificate and is seeking a private pilot certificate with an airplane single-engine land rating. Holds a first-class medical certificate, examination on 20 January 2025, with no authorization for special issuance; not suspended or revoked; no later application. On 2 February 2027 the person flies an airplane solo, exercising student pilot privileges; the flight is not conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2027-02-02

Born 5 May 1970. Holds a commercial pilot certificate with an airplane single-engine land rating and a flight instructor certificate with an airplane single-engine rating. Holds a first-class medical certificate, examination on 17 February 2025, with no authorization for special issuance; not suspended or revoked; no later application. On 28 February 2027 the person gives flight instruction in an airplane without compensation, exercising only the privileges of the flight instructor certificate (not the commercial pilot certificate), and acts as pilot in command; the flight is not conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2027-02-28

Born 9 December 1985. Holds a student pilot certificate. Holds a second-class medical certificate, examination on 8 December 2025, with no authorization for special issuance; not suspended or revoked; no later application. On 15 January 2028 the person takes the practical test for a private pilot certificate with an airplane single-engine land rating, in an airplane; the flight is not conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2028-01-15

Born 2 March 1970. Holds a commercial pilot certificate and a flight instructor certificate, both with airplane ratings, and is an Examiner. Has never held an airman medical certificate and has never applied for one. Holds a U.S. driver's license and complies with every restriction of it. On 12 November 2025 the person performs the duties of an Examiner in an airplane, administering a practical test for a commercial pilot certificate; the flight is not conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2025-11-12

Born 30 June 1998. Holds a student pilot certificate and is seeking a sport pilot certificate with balloon privileges. Has never held or applied for an airman medical certificate and holds no U.S. driver's license. On 20 May 2025 the person flies a balloon solo by day, exercising student pilot privileges. 2025-05-20

Born 11 November 1990. Holds a student pilot certificate and is seeking a private pilot certificate with a glider category rating. Last held a third-class medical certificate, examination on 4 April 2015, not suspended or revoked; no later application. On 8 August 2026 the person takes the practical test for a private pilot certificate with a glider category rating, conducted in a glider. 2026-08-08

Born 7 July 1988. Holds a sport pilot certificate with glider privileges and a flight instructor certificate with a sport pilot rating. Has never held or applied for an airman medical certificate and holds no U.S. driver's license. On 14 June 2026, by day, the person acts as pilot in command of a glider while giving flight instruction under the flight instructor certificate; the flight is not conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2026-06-14

Born 25 January 1984. Holds a commercial pilot certificate with a glider category rating and a flight instructor certificate with a glider category rating. Has never held or applied for an airman medical certificate. On 3 September 2026 the person gives flight instruction for compensation in a glider and acts as pilot in command; the flight is not conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2026-09-03

Born 19 February 1962. Holds a private pilot certificate with a lighter-than-air category, balloon class rating, and is an Examiner. Last held a third-class medical certificate, examination on 12 May 2016, not suspended or revoked; no later application. On 21 September 2025 the person administers a practical test for a private pilot certificate with a balloon class rating, conducted in a balloon, and acts as pilot in command of the balloon exercising the privileges of the private pilot certificate. 2025-09-21

Born 13 August 1977. Holds a commercial pilot certificate and a flight instructor certificate, both with airplane ratings. Last held a third-class medical certificate, examination on 6 June 2017, not suspended or revoked; no later application. On 3 March 2025 the person gives flight instruction in an airplane to a certificated private pilot who acts as pilot in command; the instructor is not acting as pilot in command and is not serving as a required pilot flight crewmember, and exercises only flight instructor privileges. 2025-03-03

Born 1 December 1958. Holds a ground instructor certificate (advanced) and no pilot certificate. Has never held or applied for an airman medical certificate. On 9 January 2026 the person gives ground training in a classroom under the ground instructor certificate. 2026-01-09

Born 16 April 1992. A military pilot of the U.S. Armed Forces who also holds a private pilot certificate with an airplane single-engine land rating. Holds no airman medical certificate and has never applied for one. Can show evidence of an up-to-date medical examination authorizing pilot flight status issued by the U.S. Armed Forces. On 4 July 2025 the person acts as pilot in command of a civil airplane on a private flight, exercising private pilot privileges; the flight is a domestic flight operation within U.S. airspace and is not conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2025-07-04

Born 8 October 1964. Holds a private pilot certificate with an airplane single-engine land rating. Last held a third-class medical certificate, examination on 14 March 2019, not suspended or revoked. Applied for a third-class medical certificate on 1 March 2026; the application is pending. On 15 April 2026 the person acts as pilot in command of an airplane on a special medical flight test authorized under part 67. 2026-04-15

Born 11 April 1985. Holds a student pilot certificate and is seeking a sport pilot certificate with airplane privileges. Holds a second-class medical certificate, examination on 11 April 2025, with no authorization for special issuance; not suspended or revoked; no later application. Does not hold a U.S. driver's license. On 30 April 2027 the person flies solo by day, exercising student pilot privileges, in an airplane that meets the performance limits and design requirements of 14 CFR 61.316; the flight is not conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2027-04-30

Born 29 May 1972. Holds a sport pilot certificate with airplane privileges. Has never held or applied for an airman medical certificate. Holds a U.S. driver's license and complies with every restriction and limitation of it; no judicial or administrative order applies to the person's operation of a motor vehicle. The person knows of a medical condition that would make them unable to operate an aircraft meeting the performance limits and design requirements of 14 CFR 61.316 in a safe manner. On 17 May 2026 the person acts as pilot in command by day of an airplane that meets the performance limits and design requirements of 14 CFR 61.316, exercising sport pilot privileges; the flight is not conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2026-05-17

Born 6 June 1975. Holds a sport pilot certificate with airplane privileges. Held a third-class medical certificate, examination on 2 May 2017, never suspended or revoked, with no authorization for special issuance. Applied for a third-class medical certificate on 15 January 2026; the application was completed and denied. Holds a U.S. driver's license and complies with every restriction of it and with every order on driving. Completed the medical education course of 14 CFR 68.3 on 4 May 2026 and retains the certification of completion. The comprehensive medical examination on 2 June 2025 was conducted in accordance with part 68 by a State-licensed physician. Has not been diagnosed with any medical condition that may impact the ability to fly; does not know or have reason to know of any medical condition that would make them unable to operate an aircraft meeting 14 CFR 61.316 in a safe manner. On 12 September 2026, at night, the person acts as pilot in command of an airplane that meets the performance limits and design requirements of 14 CFR 61.316, exercising sport pilot privileges; the flight is conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2026-09-12

Born 9 September 1958. Holds a sport pilot certificate with glider privileges. Her most recently issued medical certificate was a third-class medical certificate, examination on 6 August 2021, issued with an authorization for special issuance; that authorization was withdrawn on 10 March 2023; the certificate was not suspended or revoked. No application since. Holds a U.S. driver's license and complies with every restriction of it and with every order on driving. Completed the medical education course of 14 CFR 68.3 on 20 October 2025 and retains the certification of completion. The comprehensive medical examination on 15 September 2025 was conducted in accordance with part 68 by a State-licensed physician. Has not been diagnosed with any medical condition that may impact the ability to fly; does not know or have reason to know of any medical condition that would make her unable to operate an aircraft meeting 14 CFR 61.316 in a safe manner. On 14 February 2026, at night, she acts as pilot in command of a glider, exercising sport pilot privileges; the flight is conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2026-02-14

Born 27 January 1987. Holds a sport pilot certificate with airplane privileges and a flight instructor certificate with a sport pilot rating. Holds a third-class medical certificate, examination on 26 January 2027, with no authorization for special issuance; not suspended or revoked; no later application. Does not hold a U.S. driver's license. On 5 May 2029, by day, the person gives flight instruction under the flight instructor certificate and acts as pilot in command of an airplane that meets the performance limits and design requirements of 14 CFR 61.316; the flight is not conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2029-05-05

Born 3 March 1966. Holds a commercial pilot certificate and a flight instructor certificate with a sport pilot rating, and is an Examiner. Has never held or applied for an airman medical certificate. Holds a U.S. driver's license and complies with every restriction and limitation of it; no judicial or administrative order applies to the person's operation of a motor vehicle. Does not know or have reason to know of any medical condition that would make the person unable to operate an aircraft meeting 14 CFR 61.316 in a safe manner. On 10 October 2025 the person serves as an Examiner administering a practical test for the issuance of a sport pilot certificate in an airplane that meets the performance limits and design requirements of 14 CFR 61.316; the flight is not conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2025-10-10

Born 3 June 1960. Holds a sport pilot certificate with balloon privileges. Held a third-class medical certificate, examination on 2 February 2024, issued on that application with no authorization for special issuance; never suspended or revoked; no application since. Holds a U.S. driver's license and complies with every restriction of it and with every order on driving. Completed the medical education course of 14 CFR 68.3 on 4 May 2026 and retains the certification of completion. The comprehensive medical examination on 2 June 2025 was conducted in accordance with part 68 by a State-licensed physician. Has not been diagnosed with any medical condition that may impact the ability to fly; does not know or have reason to know of any medical condition that would make the person unable to operate an aircraft meeting 14 CFR 61.316 in a safe manner. On 10 March 2027, at night, the person acts as pilot in command of a balloon, exercising sport pilot privileges; the flight is conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2027-03-10

Born 21 November 1968. Holds a sport pilot certificate with airplane privileges. Held a third-class medical certificate, examination on 13 May 2019, never suspended or revoked, no authorization for special issuance; no application since. Holds a U.S. driver's license that carries a restriction requiring corrective lenses; the person does not comply with that restriction. No other order applies to driving. Completed the medical education course of 14 CFR 68.3 on 2 January 2026 and retains the certification of completion. The comprehensive medical examination on 9 December 2025 was conducted in accordance with part 68 by a State-licensed physician. Has not been diagnosed with any medical condition that may impact the ability to fly; does not know or have reason to know of any medical condition that would make the person unable to operate an aircraft meeting 14 CFR 61.316 in a safe manner. On 18 April 2026, at night, the person acts as pilot in command of an airplane that meets the performance limits and design requirements of 14 CFR 61.316, exercising sport pilot privileges; the flight is conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2026-04-18

Born 12 December 1980. Holds a private pilot certificate with an airplane single-engine land rating. Has never held an airman medical certificate and has never applied for one. Holds a U.S. driver's license and complies with all medical requirements and restrictions associated with it. Completed the medical education course of 14 CFR 68.3 on 1 February 2026 and retains the certification of completion. The comprehensive medical examination on 11 November 2025 was conducted in accordance with part 68 by a State-licensed physician. Has not been diagnosed with any medical condition that may impact the ability to fly. On 6 June 2026 the person acts as pilot in command of an airplane, exercising private pilot privileges; the flight is conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2026-06-06

Born 17 July 1960. Holds a private pilot certificate with an airplane single-engine land rating. Holds a U.S. driver's license and complies with all medical requirements and restrictions associated with it. Has not been diagnosed with any medical condition that may impact the ability to fly. On 15 March 2027 the person acts as pilot in command of an airplane, exercising private pilot privileges; the flight is conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2027-03-15

Born 4 April 1955. Holds a commercial pilot certificate and a flight instructor certificate, both with airplane ratings. Held a third-class medical certificate, examination on 22 August 2016, no authorization for special issuance, never suspended or revoked; no application since. Holds a U.S. driver's license and complies with all medical requirements and restrictions associated with it. Born 30 October 1962. Holds a private pilot certificate with an airplane single-engine land rating. Born 14 February 1963. Holds a commercial pilot certificate and a flight instructor certificate, both with airplane ratings, and is an Examiner. Most recently issued medical certificate: second-class, examination on 10 March 2020, no authorization for special issuance; it was revoked on 5 September 2022. No application since. On 7 July 2026 the person serves as an Examiner administering a proficiency check for an airman rating in an airplane and acts as pilot in command; the flight is conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2026-07-07

Born 8 August 1965. Holds a private pilot certificate with an airplane single-engine land rating. The person has been diagnosed with a medical condition that may impact the ability to fly and is under the care and treatment of a State-licensed physician. On 20 December 2026 the person acts as pilot in command of an airplane, exercising private pilot privileges; the flight is conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i). 2026-12-20

Born 5 May 1966. Holds a private pilot certificate with an airplane rating and a U.S. driver's license; completed the 68.3 course on 1 March 2026 and a comprehensive medical examination on 1 April 2026; last third-class medical certificate examination on 3 June 2016. On 10 June 2026 the person flies an airplane with a maximum certificated takeoff weight of 6,500 pounds carrying five passengers at 17,000 feet MSL at 230 knots. Whether this flight is conducted under the conditions and limitations of 14 CFR 61.113(i) is not stated and must be decided from these circumstances. 2026-06-10

Born 12 September 1990. Holds a sport pilot certificate with airplane privileges and a U.S. driver's license; has never applied for a medical certificate. On 21 March 2026, by day, the person flies a two-seat airplane with a maximum takeoff weight of 1,800 pounds, a stall speed of 50 knots and a retractable landing gear. Whether the airplane meets the performance limits and design requirements of 14 CFR 61.316 is not stated and must be decided from these specifications. 2026-03-21
